content:
dinesh: heads-up — ca-central-1 rwd-math-7b queue depth spiked ~4x over the last 30m. p95 token latency ~2.1s -> 4.8s, error rate creeping up. autoscaler alert fired but no new pods came up. seeing a bunch of admission rejects.

ops-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler: insufficient headroom for pool 'ca-central-1/gpu-pool-2' (0 GPUs free) — 2161234520

alex: what does the admission reject look like? can you paste a sample log line and the autoscaler config? :eyes:

maria: grabbing logs now. short snippet: 
```
I0320 14:12:23 admission_controller.go:213] reject allocation: reason="nodeLabel mismatch" required="gpu_type=a100" found="gpu_family=a100" request=slot-alloc/model=rwd-math-7b
E0320 14:12:24 allocator.go:88] allocation failed: no compatible nodes for selector
```

maria: looks like our node relabeling change last week renamed gpu_type -> gpu_family and we missed a selector in the model slot config. that makes admission-controller think there are 0 compatible nodes even though GPUs exist.

dinesh: ugh ok. so autoscaler thought pool was full because admission rejected allocations. patching model slot selector should be quick. who can patch and restart the admission-controller?

chen: I can do the patch. quick plan: 1) patch model-slot config to use gpu_family selector, 2) enable soft-throttle so non-SLO traffic gets queued instead of getting 429s, 3) temporarily route best-effort customers to eu-west-3 if latency ok.

katy: +1 to routing; QA on best-effort only. Can we change routing via feature flag on the proxy? would prefer not to touch infra routes if possible.

alex: patch and restart steps pls (kubectl commands) — i'll standby to watch metrics.

chen: applying patch now. command: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap model-slot-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/rwd-math-7b/selector","value":"gpu_family=a100"}]'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment admission-controller
```

chen: also toggling soft-throttle on admission policy with a small grace threshold so we stop 429 storms: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap admission-policy --type=merge -p '{"data":{"soft_throttle":"true","soft_throttle_threshold":"0.65"}}'
```

ops-bot: [ACTION] rollout restarted: admission-controller (revision: v2026-03-20-1) — 2161234930

maria: seeing admission rejects drop to near-zero, autoscaler now observes usable headroom and started new pods at 14:15:10. mesh reports some in-flight requests rerouted.

alex: metrics: queue depth peaked at 420 -> now 60 after 8m, p95 down to 2.4s and trending. good.

dinesh: routing switch for best-effort enabled via proxy flag: `proxy.feature.best_effort_route=eu-west-3` (only affects traffic tagged non-slo). katy can you confirm there were no errors?

katy: confirmed no proxy rejects. small increase in eu-west-3 load but under capacity.

maria: follow-up: open PR to normalize selectors across model-slot-config templates (gpu_type -> gpu_family) + add a CI check to catch selector/name mismatches.

chen: filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-4721 (selector drift + admission CI). also will revert soft-throttle to false after 24h if stable.

dinesh: summary: root cause = selector drift after node relabel; mitigation = patch selector + restart admission-controller + enable soft-throttle + temporary routing of best-effort to eu-west-3. backlog largely drained. monitoring for 1h, then close. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks everyone. add postmortem notes to the incident doc and tag oncall rotation so we can add to runbook.

ops-bot: [NOTE] incident channel created: #incident-2161234567-ca-central-math-backlog — 2161235010

dinesh: marking this thread resolved for now. will post final numbers in 1h.
